jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v1/companies/{company}/postings. Optional limit and offset page through results (response total = totalFound).

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single job via authenticated GET /jobs/{id}. Distinct from public jobs.list/postings.list.

postings.list.title: List postings
postings.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v1/companies/{company}/postings. Optional q, limit, offset, country, region, city, and department filters.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: Search candidates via authenticated GET /candidates. Optional limit, pageId, q, jobId (raw or sr-job:-prefixed; sent raw), updatedAfter, and status filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List company users via authenticated GET /user-api/v201804/users. Optional limit, pageId (cursor from nextPageId), q, and updatedAfter filters. offset is deprecated and ignored (the Users API pages by pageId).

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interviews for an application via authenticated GET /interviews-api/v201904/interviews. Requires applicationId.

candidates.create.title: Create candidate
candidates.create.description: Create a candidate in the Talent Pool via authenticated POST /candidates (201 CandidateDetails). Returns the raw candidate id plus the normalized candidate. Creates omit effectPolicy. OAuth scope candidates_create (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

tags.description: Candidate tags (max 100, each up to 150 characters).

startDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

startDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

sourceDetails.description: Candidate source; omitted defaults to the API source.

applications.create.title: Create candidate on job
applications.create.description: Create a candidate and assign them to a job via authenticated POST /jobs/{jobId}/candidates (201 CandidateDetails with primaryAssignment). Read the application UUID with applications.get. Creates omit effectPolicy. OAuth scope candidates_create (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

tags.description: Candidate tags (max 100, each up to 150 characters).

startDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

startDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

sourceDetails.description: Candidate source; omitted defaults to the API source.

candidates.update.title: Update candidate
candidates.update.description: Update candidate personal details via authenticated PATCH /candidates/{id}. Only firstName, lastName, email and phoneNumber are accepted, because candidates.get returns exactly those fields. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via candidates.get [id]. OAuth scope candidates_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

candidate.description: Normalized candidate after Reconcile via candidates.get; null when not found.

applications.get.title: Get application
applications.get.description: Get a candidate's application to a job via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}: status, subStatus, startsOn, source, rejection/withdrawal reason and the application UUID (applicationId) used by interviews.list and job_applications.get. OAuth scope candidates_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

application.description: Normalized application (candidateId, jobId, applicationId, status, subStatus, startsOn, source, reasonOfRejection, reasonOfWithdrawal, url); null when not found.

applications.update_status.title: Update application status
applications.update_status.description: Move a candidate's application to another status (stage) via authenticated PUT /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/status (204). reason is a rejection or withdrawal reason id and is only valid with status REJECTED or WITHDRAWN. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get [id, jobId]. OAuth scope candidates_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

startsOn.description: Optional ISO 8601 date-time the status takes effect (e.g. hire start date).

reason.description: Rejection reason id (GET /configuration/rejection-reasons) or withdrawal reason id (GET /configuration/withdrawal-reasons).

application.description: Normalized application (candidateId, jobId, applicationId, status, subStatus, startsOn, source, reasonOfRejection, reasonOfWithdrawal, url); null when not found.

applications.status_history.title: Get application status history
applications.status_history.description: List status changes for a candidate's application via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/status/history. OAuth scope candidates_read and candidate_status_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

candidates.tags.get.title: Get candidate tags
candidates.tags.get.description: Get the tags on a candidate via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/tags. OAuth scope candidates_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

candidates.tags.add.title: Add candidate tags
candidates.tags.add.description: Add tags to a candidate without removing existing ones via authenticated POST /candidates/{id}/tags. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the full tag set via candidates.tags.get [id]. OAuth scope candidates_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

tags.description: Candidate tags (max 100, each up to 150 characters).

candidates.tags.replace.title: Replace candidate tags
candidates.tags.replace.description: Replace all tags on a candidate with the given array via authenticated PUT /candidates/{id}/tags. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via candidates.tags.get [id]. OAuth scope candidates_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

tags.description: Candidate tags (max 100, each up to 150 characters).

candidates.attachments.list.title: List candidate attachments
candidates.attachments.list.description: List a candidate's attachments (metadata only) via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/attachments. OAuth scope candidates_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

applications.attachments.list.title: List application attachments
applications.attachments.list.description: List a candidate's attachments in the context of a job (metadata only) via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/attachments. OAuth scope candidates_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

applications.properties.get.title: Get application properties
applications.properties.get.description: Get candidate property values for a candidate's job via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/properties. OAuth scope candidates_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

properties.description: Properties (id, key, label, type, value, selectedValueLabels).

applications.properties.update.title: Update application properties
applications.properties.update.description: Set candidate property values for a candidate's job via authenticated PUT /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/properties (204). Batch upsert, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope candidates_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

textValue.description: TEXT, DATE (ISO 8601), COUNTRY (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase), REGION (ISO 3166-2, lowercase), USER (user id) or SINGLE_SELECT (value id).

optionIds.description: MULTI_SELECT option ids; an empty array clears the field.

items.description: One property value. Set at most one value field; none resets the value.

applications.screening_answers.get.title: Get screening answers
applications.screening_answers.get.description: Get screening question answers for a candidate's job via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/screening-answers. OAuth scope candidates_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

answers.description: Answers (id, type, category, name, label, records[].fields[].values[]).

job_applications.get.title: Get job application
job_applications.get.description: Get a job application by its UUID via authenticated GET /job-applications-api/v202112/job-applications/{jobApplicationId} (status, subStatus, profileId, jobId, sourceIdentifier, createDate). The UUID is applicationId from applications.get. OAuth scope job_applications_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobApplication.description: Normalized job application; null when the body is empty.

jobs.search.title: Search jobs
jobs.search.description: Search jobs via authenticated GET /jobs. Pages by pageId (nextPageId from the previous page; sort is forced to job_id). The deprecated offset and single-value status parameters are not exposed; use statuses. Each jobs[].id is sr-job:-prefixed (same form as jobs.get). OAuth scope jobs_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

sort.description: Result order; pageId paging requires job_id.

language.description: Job ad language code (e.g. en, en-GB, pt-BR).

hiringTeamMemberId.description: Only jobs whose hiring team includes any of these user ids (raw or sr-user:-prefixed, e.g. from users.list; sent raw).

nextPageId.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

jobs.create.title: Create job
jobs.create.description: Create a job via authenticated POST /jobs (201 JobDetails). industryId, functionId, experienceLevelId, typeOfEmploymentId, departmentId and eeoCategoryId are configuration ids sent as {id}. Returns the sr-job:-prefixed job id plus the normalized job. Creates omit effectPolicy. OAuth scope jobs_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

identifier.description: Predefined location identifier; mutually exclusive with the address fields.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (required unless identifier is set).

location.description: Job location: either identifier or city + countryCode.

id.description: Prefixed SmartRecruiters job id (sr-job:…); same form as jobs.get / jobs.list.

jobs.update.title: Update job
jobs.update.description: Update a job via authenticated PATCH /jobs/{jobId} (RFC 6902 JSON Patch, application/json-patch+json). Only title and refNumber are accepted, because those are the mutable JobDetails fields the connector normalizes. Effect keys are omitted: upstream PATCH may trigger job approval, so jobs.get can lag and is not an exact observe. Accepts raw job id or sr-job:-prefixed. OAuth scope jobs_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

id.description: SmartRecruiters job id (raw or sr-job:-prefixed; e.g. from jobs.search, jobs.create, or jobs.get).

job.description: Normalized job from the PATCH response body (same shape as jobs.get); null when the response carries no job. No Reconcile: jobs.update has no effect keys.

jobs.update_status.title: Update job status
jobs.update_status.description: Change a job status via authenticated PUT /jobs/{jobId}/status. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via jobs.get [id]. OAuth scope jobs_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

job.description: Normalized job after Reconcile via jobs.get (same shape as jobs.get); null when not found.

jobs.status_history.title: Get job status history
jobs.status_history.description: List job status changes via authenticated GET /jobs/{jobId}/status/history. OAuth scope jobs_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobs.hiring_team.get.title: Get hiring team
jobs.hiring_team.get.description: List hiring team members of a job via authenticated GET /jobs/{jobId}/hiring-team. OAuth scope jobs_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobs.hiring_team.add.title: Add hiring team member
jobs.hiring_team.add.description: Add a user to a job hiring team via authenticated POST /jobs/{jobId}/hiring-team (409 if already a member). Creates a membership, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope jobs_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobs.hiring_team.remove.title: Remove hiring team member
jobs.hiring_team.remove.description: Remove a user from a job hiring team via authenticated DELETE /jobs/{jobId}/hiring-team/{userId} (204). 404 (not a member) and 400 (last member) surface as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Delete, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope jobs_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobs.note.get.title: Get job note
jobs.note.get.description: Get the note of a job via authenticated GET /jobs/{jobId}/note. OAuth scope jobs_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobs.note.update.title: Update job note
jobs.note.update.description: Replace the note of a job via authenticated PUT /jobs/{jobId}/note. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via jobs.note.get [id]. OAuth scope jobs_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

content.description: Note text after Reconcile via jobs.note.get.

jobs.publish.title: Publish job
jobs.publish.description: Publish the default job ad to internal sources and free aggregators via authenticated POST /jobs/{jobId}/publication (204). Creates publications, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope jobs_publications_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

aggregators.description: Publish to free job aggregators (default true).

delayPublicInDays.description: Delay public publication by this many days.

jobs.unpublish.title: Unpublish job
jobs.unpublish.description: Unpublish a job from all sources via authenticated DELETE /jobs/{jobId}/publication (204). Delete, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope jobs_publications_manage (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobs.publications.list.title: List job publications
jobs.publications.list.description: List publications of a job via authenticated GET /jobs/{jobId}/publication. OAuth scope jobs_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

jobs.positions.list.title: List job positions
jobs.positions.list.description: List positions of a job via authenticated GET /jobs/{jobId}/positions, including position changes pending approval. OAuth scope jobs_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

postings.get.title: Get posting
postings.get.description: Get one public job posting with its job ad sections via the public Posting API GET /v1/companies/{company}/postings/{postingId} (posting id or uuid). Optional source ids are passed through for apply-URL tracking. OAuth scope: none for public postings (internal postings need internal_postings_read and are not reachable through this unauthenticated call).

posting.description: Normalized posting (raw id, uuid, jobId, title, location, sections, URLs); null when not found.

interviews.create.title: Create interview
interviews.create.description: Schedule an interview via authenticated POST /interviews-api/v201904/interviews (201 Interview). candidateId is sent as candidate.id. Returns the sr-interview:-prefixed interview id plus the normalized interview. Create, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope interviews_write (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

organizerId.description: SmartRecruiters user id of the organizer (raw or sr-user:-prefixed).

id.description: SmartRecruiters user id of the interviewer (raw or sr-user:-prefixed).

candidateStatus.description: Candidate attendee status for this slot.

location.description: Address, video link or phone number.

createdOn.description: Creation time (ISO 8601); defaults to now upstream.

refUrl.description: Reference URL in the scheduling system.

refId.description: Reference id in the scheduling system.

interviews.get.title: Get interview
interviews.get.description: Fetch one interview via authenticated GET /interviews-api/v201904/interviews/{interviewId}. OAuth scope interviews_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

interview.description: Normalized interview; null when the response has no id.

interviews.update.title: Update interview
interviews.update.description: Update an interview's location and/or timezone via authenticated PATCH /interviews-api/v201904/interviews/{interviewId} (204). Supported upstream only for interviews created via the Public API. The deprecated candidate.status field is not exposed (use timeslot candidateStatus). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via interviews.get [interviewId], which returns location and timezone verbatim. OAuth scope interviews_write (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

interview.description: Normalized interview after Reconcile via interviews.get; null when not found.

interviews.delete.title: Delete interview
interviews.delete.description: Delete an interview via authenticated DELETE /interviews-api/v201904/interviews/{interviewId} (204). Supported upstream only for interviews created via the Public API. 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Delete, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope interviews_write (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

interview_types.list.title: List interview types
interview_types.list.description: List the company's interview types via authenticated GET /interviews-api/v201904/interview-types. OAuth scope interview_types_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

messages.share.title: Share message
messages.share.description: Post a note / message via authenticated POST /messages/shares (201 MessageDetails). shareWith.users take user ids and shareWith.hiringTeamOf take job ids (raw or prefixed); everyone and openNote are mutually exclusive. Create, so effectPolicy is omitted. OAuth scope messages_write (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

correlationId.description: Optional caller reference appended to the note.

hiringTeamOf.description: Job ids whose hiring teams see the message.

everyone.description: Visible to everyone in the company.

openNote.description: Visible to everyone with access to the #-tagged candidate.

shareRequired.description: Upstream shareRequired flag; null when absent.

messages.list.title: List candidate messages
messages.list.description: List messages for a candidate via authenticated GET /messages (nextPageId comes from the Link header's rel="next" pageId; pass it back as pageId). ADMINISTRATOR role only upstream. authorId and application candidateId/jobId are sr-user: / sr-candidate: / sr-job:-prefixed. OAuth scope messages_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

nextPageId.description: Cursor for the next page from the Link rel="next" pageId; null on the last page.

offers.list.title: List application offers
offers.list.description: List offers for a candidate's application via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/offers. OAuth scope candidates_offers_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

offers.get.title: Get application offer
offers.get.description: Fetch one offer via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/offers/{offerId}. OAuth scope candidates_offers_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

offer.description: Offer (id, status, createdOn, updatedOn, properties); null when the response has no id.

offers.search.title: Search offers
offers.search.description: Search offers across the company via authenticated GET /offers (limit/offset paging). Upstream allows only Extended or Admin system-role credentials. When age is set, createdAfter/createdBefore are ignored upstream. OAuth scope candidates_offers_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

reviews.list.title: List reviews
reviews.list.description: List reviews (scorecards) for a candidate on a job via authenticated GET /reviews-api/v201910/reviews. candidateId, jobId and reviewerId in the output are sr-candidate: / sr-job: / sr-user:-prefixed. OAuth scope reviews_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

reviews.description: Reviews (id, candidateId, jobId, reviewerId, overallRating, comment, createdOn, updatedOn).

reviews.get.title: Get review
reviews.get.description: Fetch one review via authenticated GET /reviews-api/v201910/reviews/{reviewId}. OAuth scope reviews_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

review.description: Review (same shape as reviews.list rows); null when the response has no id.

scorecards.criteria.list.title: List job scorecard criteria
scorecards.criteria.list.description: List the scorecard criteria configured for a job via authenticated GET /reviews-api/v201910/jobs/{jobId}/criteria. OAuth scope jobs_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Fetch one user via authenticated GET /user-api/v201804/users/{id}. OAuth scope users_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

user.description: Normalized user (same shape as users.list rows); null when the response has no id.

users.me.title: Get current user
users.me.description: Fetch the user that owns the credentials via authenticated GET /user-api/v201804/users/me. OAuth scope user_me_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

user.description: Normalized user; null when the response has no id.

departments.list.title: List departments
departments.list.description: List company departments via authenticated GET /configuration/departments. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

departments.get.title: Get department
departments.get.description: Fetch one department via authenticated GET /configuration/departments/{id}. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

department.description: Department (id, label, description, archived); null when the response has no label.

hiring_processes.list.title: List hiring processes
hiring_processes.list.description: List hiring processes (with IN_REVIEW / INTERVIEW / OFFERED sub-statuses) via authenticated GET /configuration/hiring-processes. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

hiring_processes.get.title: Get hiring process
hiring_processes.get.description: Fetch one hiring process via authenticated GET /configuration/hiring-processes/{id}. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

hiringProcess.description: Hiring process (id, name, active, subStatuses); null when the response has no id.

rejection_reasons.list.title: List rejection reasons
rejection_reasons.list.description: List candidate rejection reasons via authenticated GET /configuration/rejection-reasons (ids feed applications.update_status reason). OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

withdrawal_reasons.list.title: List withdrawal reasons
withdrawal_reasons.list.description: List candidate withdrawal reasons via authenticated GET /configuration/withdrawal-reasons (ids feed applications.update_status reason). OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

sources.types.list.title: List candidate source types
sources.types.list.description: List candidate source types with their subtypes via authenticated GET /configuration/sources. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

sources.values.list.title: List candidate source values
sources.values.list.description: List candidate sources of one type via authenticated GET /configuration/sources/{sourceType}/values. Pages by limit/offset only (the endpoint has no pageId). OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

limit.description: Page size echoed by upstream; null when absent.

offset.description: Offset echoed by upstream; null when absent.

candidate_properties.list.title: List candidate property definitions
candidate_properties.list.description: List candidate property definitions via authenticated GET /configuration/candidate-properties. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

properties.description: Definitions (id, key, label, type, availableTo, contexts).

job_properties.list.title: List job property definitions
job_properties.list.description: List job property definitions via authenticated GET /configuration/job-properties. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

properties.description: Definitions (id, key, label, category, active, visible, required).

job_properties.values.list.title: List job property values
job_properties.values.list.description: List the values of a job property via authenticated GET /configuration/job-properties/{id}/values. Pages by pageId / pageSize; nextPageId comes from the response body. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

nextPageId.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

offer_properties.list.title: List offer property definitions
offer_properties.list.description: List offer property definitions grouped by category via authenticated GET /configuration/offer-properties. OAuth scope configuration_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

company.get.title: Get company configuration
company.get.description: Fetch the company's own configuration via authenticated GET /configuration/company. OAuth scope configuration_read or company_read (declared per operation; not part of the default connect set). API keys need the matching SmartRecruiters user permission.

company.description: Company (identifier, name, website, logo, industry, location).

postings.departments.list.title: List public departments
postings.departments.list.description: List the departments a company publishes via the public Posting API GET /v1/companies/{company}/departments. OAuth scope: none (public Posting API; called without credentials).
